notes: Comic Court: courts, robots and weapons are drawn like a comic book, with flat colors and ink outlines. Your team's color looks the same on every court, and night courts glow instead of going dark.
New effects to match: hammer slams, sword clashes and bomb blasts are bold comic-style bursts instead of glowing domes.

Pick your Hammer slam and Bomb blast in Customize. Slams: Shock Wall, Ground Star, Cracks & Rubble, Sound Effect or Speed Lines. Blasts: Classic, Mushroom Cloud, KA-BOOM!, Confetti, Fireworks or Ink Bomb, in the scoring team's color. Picking one shows it off.
A new main menu: the menu sits in the middle, and each page opens in its place with a Back button. Customize shows your robot on one side and your picks on the other.
A new HUD and menus: dark comic panels with ink lines, team score plates at the top, the kill feed in caption boxes, and a crosshair you can see on any court.
Fallen robots get thrown again by hammer hits and bomb blasts, and stop rolling once they land.
In first person, you hold the bomb in both hands in front of you.
Ramps no longer show stripes and dark patches of shadow.

New settings: Max frame rate (60 to start with) and Anti-aliasing. Menus run at 60 frames a second at most and the game slows right down while it's in the background, so computers run cooler and quieter. Show FPS shows your frame rate.
Phones: the game runs faster, with a 3D resolution setting to trade sharpness for speed, and settings lists scroll, with sliders that work, in the menu and during a match.
Fixed a switched-on setting sometimes losing its orange highlight.
What's new opens playblitzbreak.com.
